'''Kurihara Shrine''' (栗原神社) refers to several Shinto shrines in Japan:

* [[Kurihara Shrine (Zama)]] - Located in Kurihara-Chūō, Zama City, Kanagawa Prefecture.
* [[Kurihara Shrine (Takayama)]] - Located in Kamitakara, Takayama City, Gifu Prefecture.
* [[Kurihara Shrine (Higashiōsaka)]] - Located in Yoshihara, Higashiōsaka City, Osaka Prefecture.
* [[Kurihara Shrine (Maniwa)]] - Located in Kurihara, Maniwa City, Okayama Prefecture.
